name: Roswaal L. Mathers
japaneseName: ロズワール・L・メイザース
description: Roswaal L. Mathers is the Margrave of the Mathers domain, lord of Roswaal Manor, and the Head Court Mage of the Kingdom of Lugunica. The primary sponsor of the Emilia Camp, his body is inhabited by the transferred soul of his ancestor Roswaal A. Mathers. Obsessed with resurrecting his teacher Echidna according to his Book of Wisdom, he orchestrated early crises and acted as the primary antagonist of Arc 4.
